0022600118.text: The Memphis Grizzlies (2-0, 1-0 on the road, on a two-game win streak and 2nd in the Southwest, 5th in the West) visit the Sacramento Kings (0-2, 0-1 at home, on a two-game losing streak) in the Grizzlies' third game of the season. Sacramento sits 4th in the Pacific, 2 games back, and 14th in the West, and Memphis's Cedric Coward is day-to-day with a wrist sprain and a game-time decision, while the Kings are without Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf strain) and Maxime Raynaud (knee, dislocated). The teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, and Memphis won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, but the last meeting was a 123-114 loss for the Grizzlies in Memphis on February 23, 2026.
